title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta15

## Work mode persistence

This beta fixes the same class of persistence problem previously found in Global
cutting height, now for `select.*_work_mode`.

The Work mode mapping remains:

- Standard = 2
- Efficient = 3
- Precision = 4

The vendor write paths expect different encodings:

- robot: `"02" / "03" / "04"`
- cloud: `2 / 3 / 4`

The mapping is now numeric and the existing generic settings writer performs the
transport-specific encoding. No mower-model exception is added.

## Retire beta14 station-as-position override

Beta14 temporarily used the map charging-station XY as the public mower position
when a mower was confirmed docked and live MQTT was unavailable.

Field testing showed that this did not solve the underlying startup-position
problem and also discarded the mower's real pose heading, so docked mower
artwork could point in the wrong direction.

Beta15 removes that station-as-position override completely. The mower position
is again always sourced from a real mower/cloud pose. The separate beta14 fix
that derives private-cloud position age from vendor `location.report_time` is
retained.

## Generic persistence verification

Settings writes now get a second verification readback after the normal short
propagation readback. The later check does not rewrite the setting; it records
whether the vendor `set_list` still matches the acknowledged requested value.

Diagnostics expose privacy-safe status/type information only:

- `confirmed`
- `reverted`
- `missing`

This makes silent vendor encoding problems easier to detect when a setting
appears correct briefly and later returns to its previous value.

Edge sense mode and Geo-fence radius are unchanged; field testing confirmed that
they persist with their current encodings.

No Map Card update is required.
